title: Advancing the next era of national science
summary: OpenAI outlines its commitment to advancing American science working with the U.S. Department of Energy and national labs to use frontier AI to accelerate discovery.
body: OpenAI outlines its commitment to advancing American science working with the U.S. Department of Energy and national labs to use frontier AI to accelerate discovery.
summaryZh: OpenAI阐述了其与美国能源部及国家实验室合作的承诺，旨在利用前沿大模型加速国家科学研究和技术发现。原始信息显示：OpenAI outlines its commitment to advancing American science working with the U.S. Department of Energy and national labs to use frontier AI to accelerate discovery.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Advancing the next era of national science”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI宣布与美国能源部及国家实验室合作，利用前沿大模型加速科学发现。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
